warning: Do not send any of these until my role in the club is confirmed and a faculty advisor agrees. Nobody has been contacted. Fill every bracket; never send with an invented number in a first email.
rules: First email under about 150 words, one specific ask, personalised with one checked detail.
One follow-up after four to seven working days, then stop.
One person per organisation; no bulk copies; no guessed email addresses.
The faculty advisor approves the target, event and wording and is copied on every mail.
Offer only what the club controls. Do not promise attendee data, exclusivity, internships, funding or fixed audience numbers.

items.subject: A joint beginners AI challenge with IIM Sirmaur students?
items.body:
Hello [Name],

I am [Name], [your confirmed role in the club] at The Neural Network, the AI club at IIM Sirmaur. I saw [specific event or programme, checked] and it gave me an idea. Could our two groups try one small thing together: an online challenge of 60 to 90 minutes for beginners, where our students bring business problems and yours bring the technical side? We would write the problem together, each nominate one judge and share credit equally. We handle our own registrations and publish a recap. Could we have a fifteen-minute call, or begin even smaller with one volunteer mentor for one session?

Thanks, [Name] | cc: [Faculty advisor]
